question: Should source-message subagent progress become a supported opt-in channel capability, and which declared lifecycle event should own early completion cleanup?
rationale: The PR introduces a new user-facing configuration contract, while choosing between the existing `subagent_ended` semantics and a new generic early-completion capability requires explicit maintainer product and plugin-API intent.

options.title: Adopt a generic typed capability
options.body: Approve the feature after replacing the private Discord callback with one declared generic lifecycle capability while preserving the existing hook contract.

options.title: Use existing hooks only
options.body: Keep the feature plugin-local and adjust the typed `subagent_ended` timing or registration so no parallel lifecycle path is needed.

options.title: Pause for lifecycle consolidation
options.body: Wait for related yielded-parent lifecycle work to settle before committing to the public configuration and lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt a generic typed capability
recommendation.body: Approve the feature after replacing the private Discord callback with one declared generic lifecycle capability while preserving the existing hook contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history spans bundled channel seams and plugin lifecycle contracts, matching this cross-boundary product decision.
